description: Bronze earns 1 points per 100 INR of eligible net spend
Silver earns 1.25 points per 100 INR of eligible net spend
Gold earns 1.5 points per 100 INR of eligible net spend
Platinum earns 2 points per 100 INR of eligible net spend
Gift card lines never earn points
A lot expires 180 days after it is earned
Returns allowed through day 30; points become available on day 31
